one_line: This is a nonprofit event sponsorship request in a City budget agenda, not a vendor solicitation; only the portable-restroom portion fits Temporary 123.
scope: End Of The Road Ren Fair requests $20,000 in City sponsorship for an approximately 1,200-attendee event at the north side of Barney Meyring Park in Valdez, Alaska. Funding would cover toilets, entertainment, travel, advertising, cleaning, refreshments, and other event expenses; no vendor bid or RFI response is requested.
fit: Restroom trailers, portable sanitation, cleaning, water supply, and waste removal fit the company’s capabilities and fleet.
Nationwide coverage includes the stated Alaska location, but local equipment availability and delivery costs are unconfirmed.

Company NAICS 532490 and 561210 and GSA SINs 532490P, 561210FS, and 561210FAC support equipment rental and facility support. Listed opportunity NAICS 711320 is absent from the company profile; no opportunity PSC or GSA SIN is stated.
No set-aside is stated, so the company’s SBE/MBE status presents no stated set-aside barrier.
red_flags: The $20,000 is a sponsorship request covering multiple purchases, not a single available contract or confirmed appropriation.
Entertainment and overall event production exceed the company’s documented core scope.
The application names porta potties; acceptance of restroom trailers is not established.
Event start/end fields state June 19–20, 2026, while setup and teardown state June 17 and June 20, 2027.
No vendor specifications, submission instructions, evaluation criteria, mandatory site visit, or bonding requirements are provided.
Alaska mobilization and servicing costs could undermine competitiveness against the named recurring restroom supplier.
competition: The Ren Fair application identifies Petrol Management as its recurring restroom supplier, usually costing upwards of $1,500; this does not establish a 2027 award. No agency past awards, award benchmarks, or offer counts were supplied.
price_signal: The strongest relevant signal is the organizer’s statement that restroom rentals usually cost upwards of $1,500, not a documented award. The $20,000 sponsorship is not a sanitation budget. Temporary 123’s price list does not establish a comparable porta-potty rate, billing basis, or Alaska delivery and servicing price.
must_have: No vendor submission package or hard vendor requirements are established by this agenda. Source: bid pack, agenda_2026-10-22.pdf.

For sponsorship applicants only: IRS 501 nonprofit documentation, State of Alaska Non-Profit Corporation Entity License, and City of Valdez Business License; the form also requests a current W-9. These are organizer requirements, not established requirements for Temporary 123 as a supplier. Source: Ren Fair application, application restrictions and organization information.

For the organizer: $1,000,000 liability insurance documentation naming the City as Certificate Title Holder at least 30 days before the event, and a Temporary Land Use Permit application within 12 weeks of the event. Supplier applicability is unconfirmed. Source: Ren Fair application, event information and event support.
